subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw support raw `[[...]]` button JSON in model final text as a fallback for Gemini, or require Google/Gemini paths to use typed `message(action=send)` buttons only?
rationale: Current source proves the gap, but the parser approach crosses prompt, final-reply, transcript, and Telegram presentation boundaries and would make a new fallback syntax observable product behavior.

options.title: Accept A Constrained Raw Fallback
options.body: Allow a narrow raw-button parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

options.title: Retarget To Typed Routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and keep the fix focused on provider/tool prompting so Gemini uses `message(action=send)` with structured buttons.

options.title: Hold For Live Repro
options.body: Keep the issue open but avoid implementation acceptance until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Gemini/Telegram reproduction.

recommendation.title: Accept A Constrained Raw Fallback
recommendation.body: Allow a narrow raw-button parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses typed presentation contracts and Telegram button rendering, where recent mainline history points most strongly.
